record_scope_definition: Each function record hashes its complete original ELF function range. Evidence mapping is not a claim of full original-source reconstruction or live Android integration; see NOTES.md.
source_reconstruction_scope: Renderer-independent Crypt GhostAmbush01 TriggerZone geometry and the bounded offline one-player absolute-AABB contact/rising-edge path for its ordinary one-shot script.
caller_facts: The direct Crypt record is _prim_TriggerZone_GhostAmbush01, script GhostAmbush01, count 1, delay 0, with ordinary script mode and empty move-out/all-player/effect fields.
The record omits dimensions, so Zone::DeclareProperties supplies (200,200,200). Its authored object scale is (5.06089,1.43277,1).

Zone::InitPost calls GameObject::SetRelativeAABB, then UpdateAbsoluteAABB stores each local face plus the resolved GameObject position. The Crypt faces exceed SetRelativeAABB's small-extent padding boundary.

TriggerZone::Update reaches Trigger::GetNumPlayerActivating -> GameObject::GetNumPlayerTouching -> GameObject::IsTouching(GameObject const*). That path skips null Character entries and compares absolute AABBs inclusively; it does not invoke Zone::IsInside.

The host fixture uses only the authored x07_crypt_backup.mlx placement of this module at (0,19200,0), unit scale, zero rotation. Runtime-generated layouts must supply their own resolved owner world position and scale.
GhostAmbush01 resolves from local Crypt table index 2 to global script ID 17 in the original common + 007_crypt_01 table pair.
The one-shot activation count is checked before later contact sampling, so the edge latch is preserved after the first accepted edge.
unsupported: This adapter does not resolve generated level/module placement; callers provide the final GameObject world position and scale.
Zone::IsInside and its PhysicalObject guard remain a separate predicate. The trigger's AABB activation path must not acquire that guard.
No scene node, _colzone node, selector, Irrlicht collision callback, or renderer state is inferred or required by this contact path.
Online activation, multi-player policy, move-out scripts, all-player scripts, one-player effects, and associated-door bindings are outside this source record's bounded ordinary one-player slice.

The host fixture validates original script-table activation but does not prove full Android runtime wiring, frame-order behavior, rendered level completion, or the separate GhostAmbushHallway template path.
